name: The Black Race
overview: Scripture traces the origins of the nations through Noah and his sons, including Ham, whose descendants are listed as Cush, Mizraim, Phut, and Canaan, identifying the lineage associated with the Black race. The Bible records that after the Flood, God commanded Noah and his sons to multiply and fill the earth, establishing the foundation for all peoples. The mention of Moses marrying an Ethiopian (Cushite) woman reflects the presence and integration of this lineage within God's redemptive history. These passages emphasize God's sovereign role in creating diverse peoples while maintaining unity under His divine plan.
